description: Four-panel summary of both interface sides, domain-specific nematode divergence, and superposition controls
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- computed values carried from the analyses in this session ----
# IFT46 side (4UZZ chain A, 45 contact residues) mapped onto orthologs
ift46=pd.DataFrame([
 ("Danio rerio","motile",95.6,62.8,83.7,46.0),("Homo sapiens","motile",95.6,60.5,83.7,44.8),
 ("Mus musculus","motile",95.6,60.5,83.7,43.1),("Xenopus tropicalis","motile",95.6,58.1,81.4,47.4),
 ("Chlamydomonas reinhardtii","motile",88.9,52.5,75.0,51.5),("Trypanosoma brucei","motile",95.6,44.2,72.1,51.7),
 ("Drosophila melanogaster","motile",80.0,25.0,61.1,25.9),
 ("Strongyloides ratti","nematode",93.3,54.8,73.8,38.7),("Caenorhabditis elegans","nematode",97.8,52.3,72.7,39.7),
 ("Brugia malayi","nematode",97.8,50.0,75.0,47.5),("Trichinella spiralis","nematode",97.8,47.7,65.9,41.9),
 ("Caenorhabditis briggsae","nematode",93.3,35.7,64.3,35.6)],
 columns=["species","group","cov","pid","sim","nonif_pid"])
# N-term (CrIFT46 1-147) vs C-term SW scores
dom=pd.DataFrame([("Danio rerio","motile",200,306),("Xenopus tropicalis","motile",184,291),
 ("Homo sapiens","motile",164,293),("Mus musculus","motile",164,287),("Trypanosoma brucei","motile",146,263),
 ("Drosophila melanogaster","motile",112,87),("Brugia malayi","nematode",88,275),
 ("Strongyloides ratti","nematode",84,255),("Caenorhabditis elegans","nematode",80,250),
 ("Caenorhabditis briggsae","nematode",73,181),("Trichinella spiralis","nematode",25,232)],
 columns=["species","group","N","C"]); dom["ratio"]=dom.N/dom.C
# IFT52 side (4UZZ chain B, 35 contact residues)
ift52=pd.DataFrame([("Tetrahymena thermophila",100.0,100.0),("Homo sapiens",61.8,70.4),
 ("Chlamydomonas reinhardtii",53.1,63.5),("Caenorhabditis elegans",30.3,47.2)],
 columns=["species","pid","wpid"])
# superposition
sup=pd.DataFrame([("AF Tt IFT46\n(self control)",2.02,0.79),("AF C. elegans\nDYF-6",2.91,1.16)],
                 columns=["model","rmsd_all","rmsd_core"])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14.5,10))

a=ax[0,0]
d=ift46.sort_values("pid",ascending=False)
c=["#2166ac" if g=="motile" else "#b2182b" for g in d.group]
yy=np.arange(len(d))
a.barh(yy,d.pid,color=c); a.barh(yy,d.nonif_pid,color="none",edgecolor="k",hatch="///",lw=0.6)
a.set_yticks(yy); a.set_yticklabels(d.species,fontsize=8); a.invert_yaxis()
a.set_xlabel("% identity to TtIFT46 (4UZZ chain A)")
a.set_title("A  IFT46 side: solid = 45 IFT52-contacting positions,\nhatched outline = non-interface positions of same domain",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.axvline(ift46.loc[ift46.species=="Caenorhabditis elegans","pid"].iloc[0],ls=':',c='grey',lw=1)

a=ax[0,1]
for g,mk,c in [("motile","o","#2166ac"),("nematode","s","#b2182b")]:
    dd=dom[dom.group==g]; a.scatter(dd.C,dd.N,marker=mk,s=80,color=c,label=("motile cilia" if g=="motile" else "nematode, sensory cilia only"))
    for _,r in dd.iterrows():
        a.annotate(r.species.split()[0][0]+". "+r.species.split()[1],(r.C,r.N),fontsize=7,xytext=(5,2),textcoords='offset points')
a.plot([0,330],[0,330],ls=':',c='grey',lw=1)
a.set_xlabel("SW score vs TtIFT46_B_C (C-terminal, IFT52-binding)")
a.set_ylabel("SW score vs CrIFT46 1-147 (ODA16-binding)")
a.set_title("B  The ODA16 module, not the IFT52 module,\nis degenerate in nematodes",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)

a=ax[1,0]
w=0.38; yy=np.arange(len(ift52))
a.barh(yy-w/2,ift52.pid,height=w,color="#67a9cf",label="unweighted % identity")
a.barh(yy+w/2,ift52.wpid,height=w,color="#2166ac",label="contact-weighted % identity")
a.set_yticks(yy); a.set_yticklabels(ift52.species,fontsize=8); a.invert_yaxis()
a.set_xlabel("% identity at the 35 IFT46-contacting residues of IFT52")
a.set_title("C  IFT52 side: C. elegans OSM-6 keeps the\nhigh-contact anchors (K426, N380, L387, L422, F425)",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)

a=ax[1,1]
xx=np.arange(len(sup)); w=0.35
a.bar(xx-w/2,sup.rmsd_all,w,color="#bbbbbb",label="all 44 interface CA")
a.bar(xx+w/2,sup.rmsd_core,w,color="#1b7837",label="core after 3 A outlier trim")
for i,(r1,r2) in enumerate(zip(sup.rmsd_all,sup.rmsd_core)):
    a.text(i-w/2,r1+0.05,f"{r1:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=9); a.text(i+w/2,r2+0.05,f"{r2:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=9)
a.set_xticks(xx); a.set_xticklabels(sup.model,fontsize=9); a.set_ylabel("Kabsch RMSD to 4UZZ chain A (A)")
a.set_title("D  AlphaFold DYF-6 reproduces the interface epitope\nnearly as well as the self control",fontsize=10,loc='left')
a.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); a.set_ylim(0,3.4)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(ift46.round(1).to_string(index=False)); print(); print(dom.round(2).to_string(index=False))
print(); print(ift52.round(1).to_string(index=False)); print(); print(sup.to_string(index=False))
